We need to find template that when applied to the molecule (target) reproduces the reaction: protecting an alcohol with TBS group. The retrosynthetic step: target molecule contains TBS-protected alcohol? Actually the given molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. Let's examine: It has an O attached to a carbon (maybe a free OH). The TBS group is not present; the description says bond O-Si broken and aliphatic hydroxyl formed, TBS gone. So retrosynthesis: we need to break O-Si bond to get free alcohol and TBSCl? Actually forward reaction: protect alcohol with TBSCl, forming O-Si bond, removing TBS group in deprotection. In retrosynthesis, we want to go from protected molecule to alcohol precursor (free OH) and TBS reagent (maybe TBDMSCl). So we need template that breaks O-Si bond, forming aliphatic hydroxyl functional group, and removing t-butyldimethylsilyl group.

Our search criteria used broken functional group aliphatic hydroxyls (makes sense) and formed t-butyldimethylsilyl (but forward reaction forms TBS, so retrosynthetic broken is TBS, formed is hydroxyl). Actually we need to invert: In forward reaction, TBS is formed, hydroxyl is broken. In retrosynthesis, we break TBS (i.e., functional group broken is t-butyldimethylsilyl) and form aliphatic hydroxyls. The tool expects forward reaction criteria. So we should set functional_groups_broken = ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"], functional_groups_formed = ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].

Let's search again.
